title: Lagoon Markdown package manifest v1, specification revision 1.3
description: Structural schema for lagoon.json. Unicode grapheme-cluster length limits require an additional implementation check.
$comment: Specification revision 1.2 introduced the square decoded thumbnail requirement without changing the manifest formatVersion. Image bytes and dimensions require validation outside JSON Schema.

formatVersion.$comment: JSON Schema treats 1 and 1.0 as the same integer value. Writers should emit the canonical JSON token 1.

title.$comment: Must contain at most 120 extended grapheme clusters. JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode code points.

description.$comment: Must contain at most 500 extended grapheme clusters. JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode code points.

thumbnail.$comment: The referenced root-level PNG, JPEG, or WebP file must decode to equal pixel width and height. JSON Schema cannot inspect archive entries or image dimensions.
